title: Quiz: Semantic HTML
description: Check your understanding of Semantic HTML.

questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in HTML?
questions.explanation: In HTML, <!-- --> marks a comment. Block comments use -->.

questions.question: Why prefer <main> over <div class="main">?
options: It conveys meaning to browsers, SEO, and assistive tech
questions.correctAnswer: It conveys meaning to browsers, SEO, and assistive tech
questions.explanation: Semantics communicate structure, not just appearance.
